why: A (universes at 0) is lemma_9_4_6 and isMeasureZero_setOf_relTangent_ne_top for every subset K of every smooth finite-dimensional Mathlib manifold with corners (any model I : H → E), plus three Euclidean lemmas: span_unitDirections (the hull of the text's unit directions is the span of Mathlib's tangent cone), the cone estimate exists_pos_measure_cone_lt, and the density statement addHaar_setOf_span_tangentConeAt_ne_top for every A ⊆ E and every Haar measure. B is the case K = j⁻¹(Mᵢ ∩ Mᵢ') in a sheet Nᵢ modelled on [0,∞)ⁿ: A ⇒ B is lemma_9_4_6 for K' = j⁻¹(K), since j⁻¹(K ∖ j(K'^e)) ⊆ K' ∖ K'^e (no injectivity needed). B ⇒ A fails for a genuine reason: B's sets are closed in Nᵢ and its manifolds are quadrant-modelled sheets, so neither arbitrary subsets, arbitrary models, nor the three Euclidean lemmas follow. Both sides use the project's essentialSet and IsMeasureZero in Nᵢ (B's author read them as Definitions 9.4.1 (2) and 9.4.5), so this item compares scope, not the notions.
overlap: n/a (B_to_A not proved). A_to_B uses only A's fifth conjunct and IsMeasureZero.mono.
